name: Simplenote
description: Simplenote integrates electron-updater: it checks and retrieves updates, reports progress, and calls the install action after user confirmation. The project also declares electron-builder and macOS notarization tooling; the checked application source does not independently establish SHA512 enforcement or signing of Linux release artifacts.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot at the recorded commit, not historical release re-verification; electron-updater internals, generated update manifests, and released artifact signatures were not audited.
